four @bot templates i actually run. not demos. the real enchiladas, fine tuned to perfection:

HERMES SSH Relay — talk to a Desktop-primary hermes when :8642 isnt up yet
https://x.ai/bot/NVF3Rx9T7jkQPsqYjeDn-

HERMES API Fleet — the steady path. hermes over http API  :8642 via @Tailscale 
https://x.ai/bot/5KLpaL-JIM2q629kbTh5L

HERMES Full Fleet Ops — the commander. updates, homogenize, secrets, health (built around @herdrdev)
https://x.ai/bot/rzq0UV2MmBsvVR1EspZE-

N8N Master — a dedicated grokbot for @n8n_io. workflows from inside @bot
https://x.ai/bot/Zvqbrq6yN68ijhEpRz0lU

together this creates an unstoppable 24/7, fully maintained, orchestrated, token maximized mega fleet of hermes devices that appear as actual GROKBOTs in the GROKBOT app.

@NousResearch
